**Plan, three edits, no code yet.**

1. `[cli.js:9](src/cli.js:9)` parse args. `report --json` sets a flag. Unknown flags print `USAGE`, exit 1.
2. Add `toJson(rows)` beside `toTable` in `[format.js:20](src/format.js:20)`. Just `JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2)`.
3. `[cli.js:14](src/cli.js:14)` picks one printer. `buildRows()` stays untouched.

One call to make. The table drops `owner` and `slow` on purpose. I would emit the full row in JSON. Say the word if you want the four table columns only.
